goal: Lets libbitcoinkernel applications override the clock so validation and IBD logic run deterministically
Solves the problem of validation reading the system clock directly, which makes results non-reproducible for test harnesses and simulators
reviewability: Ready: CI passes and every specific review comment has been addressed with follow-up pushes
Open design questions on API shape are an invitation to review, not a blocker, but expect further rebases from conflicts with other in-flight PRs
agreement: Positive overall, no reviewer opposes merging the concept
Several inline objections were raised and all were fixed by the author (maflcko, sedited, stickies-v)
Verified by testing: reviewer asked for tests exercising fake time, author added them (sedited)
Unresolved design debate over setter vs callback-based API, author open to either (stickies-v)
